name: Stonclad
positioning: Stonhard's heavy-duty flagship line. Abrasion, impact, and chemical resistant for aggressive spaces. Direct competitor of Sikafloor PurCem HD-class products and MasterTop trowel mortars.

name: Stonshield
positioning: Safe, easy-to-clean, durable systems with design flexibility. Slip-resistant broadcast finishes. Used in food prep, kitchens, locker rooms.

name: Stonblend
positioning: Smooth, stain-resistant decorative seamless flooring. For showroom / retail / commercial spaces requiring aesthetic finish.

name: Stoncrete
positioning: Epoxy-based micro terrazzo-like floor with aggregate options (quartz, recycled glass). Decorative high-traffic system. Competes with Sikafloor EM-10 and Flowcrete Mondéco.

name: Stoncrete EFX
positioning: Premium decorative aggregate variant of Stoncrete. C-2 Amber / Mirror / NJ Quartz finish options visible in TDS list.
tds_referenced: Stoncrete EFX C-2 NJ Quartz SDS

name: Stonchem
positioning: High-performing resin chemistries for ultra-corrosive environments. The single brand that competes with Sikafloor Novolac epoxy + vinyl-ester. For acid bunds, plating zones, battery rooms.

name: Stonkote
positioning: Stonhard's thin-film coatings line. Resinous floor coatings for commercial and industrial protection — competes with Sikafloor-264 topcoat / MultiDur thin-film range.
